```artifact
Feature: Medicines Delivery and Patient Management

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given the system is up and running
    When a new patient is registered with the following details:
      | Name     | Age | Gender | Contact Number |
      | John Doe | 30  | Male   | 1234567890     |
    Then the patient should be registered successfully
    And the patient's details should be stored in the system

  Scenario: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given a patient with ID "P001" exists in the system
    When the details of the patient with ID "P001" are viewed
    Then the patient's details should be displayed
    And when the patient's details are updated with the following information:
      | Name     | Age | Gender | Contact Number |
      | Jane Doe | 32  | Female | 0987654321     |
    Then the patient's details should be updated successfully
    And the latest details should be maintained by the system

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details - A Patient cannot be deleted if there is one or more Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given a patient with ID "P002" exists in the system and has one consultation request in the last 3 years
    When an attempt is made to delete the patient with ID "P002"
    Then the deletion should be denied
    And an error message should be displayed indicating that the patient cannot be deleted due to active consultation requests

  Scenario: Rollback by a month
    Given a backup exists for the current month
    When a rollback by a month is initiated
    Then the backup for the previous month should be restored
    And the dummy production database should be purged
    And the backup should be maintained in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital

  Scenario Outline: Medicines are delivered as prescribed by the doctor (offline)
    Given a prescription with the following details:
      | Medicine Name | Dosage | Frequency | Duration |
      | <Medicine Name> | <Dosage> | <Frequency> | <Duration> |
    When the prescription is submitted offline
    Then the medicines should be delivered as prescribed
    Examples:
      | Medicine Name | Dosage | Frequency | Duration |
      | Paracetamol   | 500mg  | 2 times a day | 5 days    |
      | Aspirin       | 100mg  | 3 times a day | 3 days    |
      | Ibuprofen     | 200mg  | 1 time a day  | 7 days    |
```
